memoryExperiment.notes: Plan section 12 item 4. Both arms are the harness CompactionPolicy a run gets from compaction.policy in .agents/harness.json; the 6,000-token window makes every long task fold at least once.

notes: Plan section 20, campaign 3 (work package 8): current against masking and hybrid on tasks long enough to compact. The default becomes the cheapest arm that passes the non-inferiority gate; both treatments are paired against current in one report. An arm whose attempts recorded no fold or mask is reported as not exercised. The question is non-inferiority on verified success with an absolute margin of 0.15 (15 points), Holm-corrected over its two treatments; adoption also needs a cost ratio below 1 over the used tasks. The margin and the cost ceiling are the owner's to change. minTasks is 10: with the 3 to 5 tasks its tag selects today the verdict reads "No decision" with the reason "N tasks, 10 needed", which is the honest state until the task set grows.
